svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 07 · Riverside · 09/12 Inland Summer (Common)
svg.desc: Afternoons get hot out here. Find a shade tree, a sprinkler, or the coolest room you know. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
